title: A program for a robot
instruction: Put the blocks in order: input, processing and output. The robot drives straight, turns left and lights up at the finish.
debrief: The robot's program has an input (the button), processing (moves in an exact order) and an output (the light). Swap two moves and the robot ends up somewhere else.
why: The program waits for the input: it starts only when button A is pressed.
First it drives straight for 3 squares.
Then it turns. If it turned earlier, it would go a different way.
After the turn it drives 2 squares to the finish.
The output: the light comes on only once the robot is at the finish.
